newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy urges Yugoslavia to open internal dialogue.
newsitem.headline: Italy urges Yugoslavia to open internal dialogue.

text.p: Italy said on Wednesday it was time for Serbia's government and opposition to open a dialogue aimed at improving democracy after Belgrade's parliament reinstated annulled opposition victories.
A Foreign Ministry statement said Italy welcomed Tuesday's passage of a special law by the Socialist-dominated parliament reinstating annulled victories in 14 cities in November polls.
The statement said Italy was now awaiting "the start of a constructive dialogue between the government and opposition for the democratisation of the political system in Serbia".
The passage of the special law came after three months of daily protests and widespread international condemnation of the Serbian government for annulling the local elections.
